source.version: Part 14 — Abiotic Disorders and Diagnostic Reasoning — Batch 04
source.publicationAuthorization: Project owner authorized continued website publication on 2026-08-29. Independent specialist approval remains a separate project-control field and is not implied by publication.
source.releaseTimeReview: THC-ENC-276–280 were reconciled against the controlled Volume 14 manuscript plus current official greenhouse irrigation-water guidance, extension phytotoxicity and drift diagnostics, cannabis architecture evidence with general wound-mechanics limits, and current plant-diagnostic laboratory sampling guidance. Public wording separates pH from alkalinity and hardness, prohibits chemical-use recipes, treats contact/wound patterns as evidence rather than identity, rejects residue appearance as chemical proof, and requires representative sampling plus predefined verification for case closure.
source.note: This batch completes controlled Volume 14 with source-water chemistry, chemical phytotoxicity, mechanical injury, spray/residue investigation, and diagnostic sampling/corrective-action verification.
